messages:
sofia: RFC draft up: SDK retries + streaming ergonomics. Need prioritization from PM/eng. Two asks from customers: (1) nicer timeout/hedging surface, (2) resume-on-retry for streaming. TL;DR doc: https://go.redwood/rfc/sdk-retries-stream-resume

kim: skimmed. can we make acceptance criteria concrete? customers want: stable client behavior, measurable latency tail improvements, and backwards compat for existing calls.

raj: agree. technical risk: resume-on-retry for streaming requires server support for chunked continuation + idempotency tokens. That’s non-trivial.

mike: from devex perspective we should prioritize ergonomics first (clear api for deadlines/hedging/backoff) then explore streaming resume as 2-phase work. customers can get 90% of benefit from hedging + KV cache hints. :thumbsup:

sofia: proposal: split into two milestones. M1: API ergonomics + default backoff/hedging + non-breaking defaults + telemetry for failures. M2: streaming resume prototype (opt-in) + server protocol changes + e2e tests.

kim: acceptance criteria for M1 (draft):
- SDK exposes deadline and hedging at call-level and client-level (boolean + max_concurrency)
- Default behaviors are safe for existing workloads (no breaking changes)
- Telemetry: histograms for request latency, retry counts, hedging wins/fails, error codes (per-route)
- Docs + migration guide + example code (JS, Python)

raj: edge cases to call out:
- Partial tokens produced before retry (how to dedupe on server)
- Streaming cancellations vs network flaps (client must not duplicate callbacks)
- Backpressure signals from server during hedged requests

mike: quick config example to discuss:
```json
{
  "client": {"default_deadline_ms": 3000, "hedging": {"enabled": true, "max_forks": 2, "backoff_ms": 200}},
  "routes": {"/v1/chat": {"deadline_ms": 5000}}
}
```

sofia: good. add metrics SLA for M1: heatmap of p50/p95/p99 latency pre/post & retry ratio < 10% for stable routes. Also include rollout gating: canary with 5% traffic and automatic rollback if error budget consumption > 2x baseline.

kim: prioritization vote: my vote = M1 high, M2 medium. M2 has higher infra dependency. +1 for separate RFC for streaming resume protocol.

raj: +1 on M1 high. for M2 we need prototype work from eng-runtime and eng-platform. I'll reach out to infra owners.

mike: +1. devex can produce migration guides and small code samples for JS/Py within sprint.

devex-bot: Reminder: create follow-up issue in ADO board for M1 acceptance criteria (auto-created ticket #4521).

sofia: action items:
- kim: finalize acceptance criteria doc and add to RFC by EOD Thu
- raj: feasibility spike for streaming resume (3 days) and list server changes
- mike: draft JS/Py examples + migration guide (start Wed)
- kim & sofia: define canary rollout plan and SLO gates

ci-bot: canary pipeline queued for branch rfc/sdk-retries (build queued)

sofia: thanks everyone — we'll sync in Friday sync to lock scope. :calendar:
